about_short_description.short_description: Tenable provides an exposure management platform to identify and mitigate risks.

product.name: Tenable One Exposure Management Platform
product.description: An AI-powered platform that unifies asset inventory, exposure intelligence, attack-path analysis, risk prioritization, remediation orchestration and reporting across cloud, IT, OT, identity and AI environments.

product.name: Tenable Cloud Security
product.description: A cloud security platform that provides visibility, risk analysis and remediation for multi-cloud and hybrid environments, including cloud workloads, identities, data, containers, Kubernetes, AI resources and infrastructure as code.

product.name: Tenable Vulnerability Management
product.description: A cloud-based vulnerability management platform that continuously discovers and tracks assets, assesses vulnerabilities, adds risk context, prioritizes remediation and provides reporting.

product.name: Tenable Nessus
product.description: A vulnerability assessment scanner for identifying security weaknesses, configuration issues and compliance gaps across IT environments through automated scanning and policy-based audits.

product.name: Tenable OT Security
product.description: A security solution for converged operational technology and IT environments that discovers assets, identifies security blind spots and prioritizes high-risk exposures.

product.name: Tenable Identity Exposure
product.description: An identity security solution that assesses Active Directory, hybrid identity and Entra ID environments to identify privileged-identity weaknesses and prioritize identity-based attack paths.
